name: XMonitor - Order Status Polling Staging
description: Staging. Called by pg_cron (trigger_order_polls) only when Order Info has due rows: polls SMM order status, updates Supabase order/post state, sends final Telegram notifications once.

parameters.query:
SELECT *
FROM public."Order Info"
WHERE normalized_status IN ('pending', 'in_progress')
  AND next_check_at <= now()
ORDER BY next_check_at ASC
LIMIT 50;

UPDATE public."Order Info"
SET
  provider_status = $2,
  normalized_status = $3,
  status_response = $4::jsonb,
  -- Provider NULL means "did not tell us": keep the last known value instead of erasing it.
  -- coalesce(0, remains) is still 0, so a countdown to zero is unaffected.
  charge = coalesce($5::numeric, charge),
  start_count = coalesce($6::integer, start_count),
  remains = coalesce($7::integer, remains),
  currency = coalesce($8, currency),
  poll_attempts = poll_attempts + 1,
  last_checked_at = now(),
  -- Backoff by attempts already made (poll_attempts is the pre-increment value
  -- here): +15m, +30m, +1h, +2h, then every 4h. pg_cron's trigger_order_polls()
  -- only calls this workflow when a row is due, and stops polling after 48 h.
  next_check_at = CASE
    WHEN $3 IN ('completed', 'partial', 'canceled', 'failed') THEN next_check_at
    ELSE now() + CASE poll_attempts
      WHEN 0 THEN interval '15 minutes'
      WHEN 1 THEN interval '30 minutes'
      WHEN 2 THEN interval '1 hour'
      WHEN 3 THEN interval '2 hours'
      ELSE interval '4 hours'
    END
  END,
  last_error = $9,
  completed_at = CASE
    WHEN $3 IN ('completed', 'partial', 'canceled', 'failed') THEN COALESCE(completed_at, now())
    ELSE completed_at
  END
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING *;

UPDATE public."Posts"
SET status = $2
WHERE post_id = $1
RETURNING post_id, status;

conditions.leftValue: ={{ ['completed', 'partial', 'canceled', 'failed'].includes($('Update Order Info Status').item.json.normalized_status) && !$('Update Order Info Status').item.json.notified_at }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE public."Order Info"
SET notified_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid
  AND notified_at IS NULL
RETURNING id, notified_at;

-- Compared IN SQL so the shared secret never enters n8n execution data; only
-- the boolean does. pg_cron's trigger_order_polls() signs with the same Vault
-- row. Fails closed: missing/empty/wrong header or missing Vault row -> false.
select exists (
  select 1 from vault.decrypted_secrets
  where name = 'order_poll_secret'
    and decrypted_secret = $1
) as authorized;
